children.game_version: A follow-the-leader game using the 6-count rhythm.

seniors.seated_version: Perform the 6-count rhythm with feet and arms while seated.
seniors.standing_version: Perform the steps with support from a partner or barre.
seniors.tempo_and_range: Reduced tempo and smaller step range.

movement_profile.arms_and_hands: Closed waltz position with outside hands pointing in the line of direction.
movement_profile.footwork: Six-count pattern consisting of long glides and small leaps.
movement_profile.formation_and_space: Couple dance moving in a line of direction.
movement_profile.partnering: Closed position, partners move in opposition.

signature_moves.description: Partners hold hands and move forward and back with balance steps.
signature_moves.name: Pursuit

movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Avoid scrambling or losing the 6-count rhythm.

music_profile.musical_form: Three-part structure often including a pursuit, waltz, and coda.
music_profile.sound_description: A 3/4 time dance music that is slower than a standard waltz, characterized by a distinct rhythmic accentuation.

teaching.level_notes: Requires coordination of long glides and small leaps in a 6-count rotation.
